description:
Remembering the times when our babies were inside the belly!  And that photo session we had :) 

And to think we didn’t know our girls yet…❤️❤️ and that our best adventure was about to come. We are so in love of being parents ! Thank you God for this opportunity !!
transcript: I was rushing to the morning gray, on just another random day I picked a dandelion from the ground And the world stopped spinning around while the clouds drew pictures in blue trees whistled the whole way through i tried to keep a steady place but the sunlight held me in place. I just love the beautiful things, the painted sky that evening brings. I keep saying I'll be there by 10, then the sunset changes my plans.
